Q-9877: Days from 2022-10-13 to 2023-01-22 (count end date but not start date) = 101

Calculation:
- Oct 13 to Oct 31: 18 days
- November: 30 days
- December: 31 days
- Jan 1 to Jan 22: 22 days
- Total: 18 + 30 + 31 + 22 = 101
